# Build pipeline and generated files

Reference for what is generated, from what, and which command refreshes it. Moved out of CLAUDE.md 2026-10-16. Never hand-edit a generated file.

- `data.py` — single source of truth for every macro. Edit macros HERE only.
- `template.html` — HTML/CSS/JS shell (shared top bar + macro cheatsheet UI);
  `__DATA__` is replaced with the macro JSON at build time, `__PAGE_MACROS__` /
  `__PAGE_BUILDS__` / `__PAGE_ADDONS__` / `__PAGE_LAUNCH__` are replaced with `aria-current="page"` markers.
  Each macro-type group (Damage/offensive, Wand, etc.) renders as a "tabbed picker":
  a row of pill buttons (one per macro in that group) plus a single code panel below
  that swaps when a pill is clicked, styled after warcrafttavern.com/forever's macro
  guide layout. Search results still use the old always-expanded list style
  (`groupHTML`/`details.section`), since search spans multiple classes/groups at once.
  Also holds the addon **export mode** ("Export macros" toggle, checkboxes,
  export tray, `R2F1:` import string, selection in localStorage `wf-export-v1`);
  spec and build decisions in `ADDON_PLAN.md` sections 4 and 7.
- `build.py` — generates `macros.html` and `wow-forever-macros.md` from `data.py` +
  `template.html`, then runs `addon/tools/gen_plan_data.js` (node) which writes the addon's
  `addon/RoadToForever/PlanData.lua` from `launch-plan.html` (PLANS, PHASES) and
  `launch-plan-waypoints.json` (waypoints for the in-game Plan tab, ADDON_PLAN 15.5; per-race lists: skyborne, dwarf, gnome, human, nightelf). Never
  hand-edit `PlanData.lua`; after changing launch-plan.html's PLANS/PHASES or the waypoints JSON,
  run `python build.py` (the addon tests fail if it is stale).
- `addon/RoadToForever/MacroData.lua` — GENERATED by `build.py` from `data.py`: every macro as one `R2F1:` import string
  (byte-identical to the site's export tray with everything ticked; the addon tests compare it with the page's own JS).
  `Bundle.lua` installs it at login once per `version` (hash), through the normal Import path. Never hand-edit; after any
  `data.py` change run `python build.py` (`python build.py --check-macro-data` = exit 1 if stale; the addon tests run it).
  A macro change therefore needs an addon release to reach players in game.
- `macros.html`, `wow-forever-macros.md` — generated output. Never hand-edit; run
  `python build.py`.

- `bis/` — Mr.BiZ data. `bis/raw/<class>-<spec>.json` = ForeverDB's BiS page for that spec (level 30 PvE), one per
  spec (27; Feral = "Feral (Bear)", ForeverDB weights it for tanking). `python bis/build_bis.py` parses each source
  sentence (type, label, group, profession / skill, instance, drop %, faction) and writes `bis-data.json` +
  `addon/RoadToForever/BiZData.lua`; `--check` = exit 1 if stale (the addon tests run it). `build.py` runs it too.
  `bis/sources.json` = sources for rank 2-3 picks that are no spec's best pick (ForeverDB item pages, same sentence
  wording as the BiS pages); the build stops if a next pick has no source. `bis/places.json` = where a source is
  (dungeon entrance by instance name, vendor by name, reputation by faction; zone + x/y + conf like the plan
  waypoints) for the addon's BiZNav arrow: the build adds `place` to matching rows and a `places` table to both outputs,
  and stops on a place no row uses. Enchants: the build also reads professions.html's `DATA` (BiS enchants, via
  `node bis/enchants_from_professions.js`) and adds `enchants` (per gear slot) + `enchantPage` to every spec, using
  `ENCHANT_PAGE` (our spec -> ForeverChanges page name, always a PvE page; Feral = Druid Tank, Fury = Warrior Arms,
  Subtlety = Rogue Combat, Discipline = Priest Holy) and `ENCHANT_SLOTS`; it stops on an unknown slot or page. So an
  enchant edit on professions.html needs `python bis/build_bis.py` (the addon tests catch a stale BiZData). bis.html
  shows them as an "Enchant:" line in an opened row (links to professions.html#bis/<class>), the addon under a slot's
  picks. Item rarity is baked in (owner, 2026-10-13): `bis/quality.json` (`{quality: {id: 0-5}}`, read from Wowhead's
  Forever tooltip API in a browser on the live site, since the shell can't reach Wowhead) -> a top-level `quality`
  table in both outputs; bis.html's `whLink` and the addon's `BiZ.Quality` use it when the live lookup has nothing
  (the live lookups stay as they were). The build only notes ids missing from the file; refresh it when items
  change (in Chrome on bis.html: fetch `https://nether.wowhead.com/forever/tooltip/item/<id>` for every id,
  field `quality`). Refreshing the data: `bis/README.md`. New source wording that the parser doesn't know raises an error on purpose:
  add a rule to `parse_source`, don't hand-edit the outputs.

- `addon/art/` — the addon's art pipeline: `export_arrow3d.py` renders the waypoint arrow looks in Blender into `media/arrow3d*.tga` sprite sheets
  (models `blender_arrow3d*.py`, shared `blender_arrow_parts.py` / `blender_arrow_render.py`, painted pictures via `make_image_looks.py` +
  `sources/`), `export_arrow.py` the flat dart, `export_logo.py` the logo. Details in ADDON_PLAN section 21. Release = all checks green first.

- `ADDON_PLAN.md` — plan for the "Road to Forever" in-game addon (macro import,
  talent import/export, minimap button, Plan, BiS, arrow; built; see addon/RoadToForever/README.md). Read it before touching
  anything addon-related, the `short`/`icon` macro fields, or the talent link format.

## Quest weapons (launch plan, site and addon)
`bis/build_quest_weapons.py` (run by `build.py`) reads `bis/quest-weapons.json` and writes `addon/RoadToForever/QuestWeaponData.lua`
and `launch-plan-weapons.json`. Never hand-edit either. `CLASS_USE` in that script is the one class weapon table; both outputs
carry it. The addon scores upgrades against the worn gear; the site cannot, so it ranks by dps (casters unranked).
